h1: Seekers Finders Rama IV Bangkok — Budget 3-Star Next Door to MedPark Hospital, Rooftop Pool Included
intro: Seekers Finders Rama IV Hotel, SureStay Collection by Best Western is the closest practical hotel to MedPark Hospital in this stretch of Rama IV Road — just approximately 200 metres, around a 2–3 minute walk along the pavement. MRT Khlong Toei is 300 m further in the opposite direction. This lifestyle 3-star opened in 2022 under the Best Western SureStay Collection banner: 81 rooms with a rooftop infinity pool overlooking the Bangkok skyline, Charlie's Restaurant, and free parking. It scored 8.9 out of 10 from 725 real guest reviews on Trip.com. Rooms start from approx. ฿1,400/night for a Superior room.

body.html: For families with a patient at MedPark Hospital, the location here is almost too convenient to believe. Step out of the lobby, turn onto Rama IV Road, and MedPark's entrance appears within roughly 200 metres — no Grab, no waiting, no extra expense during what is already a stressful time. The hotel occupies a narrow lot on a busy section of Rama IV, its bamboo-patterned facade standing out against the older shophouses around it. MRT Khlong Toei is 300 m in the other direction, making the rest of Bangkok accessible without a car.

The hotel opened in 2022 and the rooms still feel new. Spaces are noticeably larger than the Bangkok 3-star average, with a minibar, microwave, kettle, and Smart TV included in every category. Beds are consistently praised in reviews for being thick and comfortable — the kind of detail that matters most when you are returning exhausted from a full day at the hospital. Cleanliness scores 9.2 on Booking.com, well above what most properties in this tier achieve.

The rooftop pool is the surprise flourish that makes the price feel even better. An outdoor infinity-edge pool with Bangkok city views at night is not something you expect from a 3-star on a budget. Multiple reviews single it out as the stay highlight — a chance to decompress under the stars after hours inside a hospital corridor.

"Room was clean, spacious, and the bed was incredibly comfortable. Check-in was smooth and the staff were genuinely helpful. Rooftop pool with the city view at night was stunning — far better than I expected for the price."

Staff earn a 9.1 service score on Booking.com. Check-in runs quickly and without fuss, which matters more than most hotels realise for guests arriving from long journeys or straight from the hospital. Charlie's Restaurant serves breakfast with a mix of Thai and international dishes; most reviewers rate it good value and tasty enough to justify the modest surcharge. Free parking removes one logistical headache for families driving in from the provinces.

Honest downsides: the location is in working-class Khlong Toei, not a tourist district. A handful of reviews mention the approach street looks uninviting, and the area is not somewhere to wander at night for entertainment. Room views in lower floors or street-facing rooms are mostly older buildings and rooftops rather than skyline. A few reviews also flag some street noise from Rama IV in rooms on lower floors. None of these are dealbreakers for the target traveller — someone who needs a clean, well-positioned base near MedPark rather than a holiday atmosphere.

Overall, Seekers Finders Rama IV holds an 8.9 out of 10 on Trip.com across 725 reviews, and a value-for-money score of 8.9 on Booking.com — suggesting guests consistently feel they got more than they paid for. Rooms start from approximately ฿1,400–1,600/night for a Superior in the regular season, rising to ฿1,800–2,200 for a Deluxe, and up to around ฿3,200+ for a Suite during peak periods. For multi-night stays while a family member is being treated at MedPark, this is the most sensible budget option in the immediate area.

honestSummary: Seekers Finders Rama IV is the most practical budget hotel for anyone with a patient at MedPark Hospital — clean new rooms, a genuinely helpful team, a rooftop pool nobody expects at this price, and a two-minute walk to the hospital entrance. The trade-off is a gritty neighbourhood and unremarkable room views. For what it is, it delivers consistently.
honestChecks: If you want a lively tourist area to explore in the evenings — Khlong Toei is a working neighbourhood, not a hotel zone. → This property suits hospital visits, not sightseeing. For nightlife or malls, take the MRT two stops to Sukhumvit.
If you are a light sleeper in a lower-floor room — Rama IV is a busy arterial road and some rooms pick up traffic noise. → Request a higher floor or a room on the non-road side when checking in.

If you need a city-view room — views from many rooms face surrounding rooftops and older buildings. → For genuine skyline views, specify a high-floor city-view room when booking and confirm with the hotel.

tips.title: Walking Route to MedPark Hospital
tips.body: Turn right out of the hotel entrance and walk east along Rama IV Road. MedPark Hospital appears on your left in roughly 200 metres — about a 2–3 minute flat walk, no road crossings needed.

tips.title: Using MRT Khlong Toei
tips.body: MRT Blue Line (Khlong Toei) is 300 m away — a 4-minute walk. Connects directly to Silom, Lumpini, Sukhumvit, and Chatuchak. Far cheaper than Grab during rush hour.

tips.title: Finding Food Nearby
tips.body: Khlong Toei Market is about 7 minutes on foot with cheap and varied street food. Several 7-Eleven and Family Mart stores are on Rama IV within easy walking range. Charlie's restaurant in the hotel is a reliable fallback.

tips.title: Free Parking
tips.body: The hotel offers complimentary parking for all guests — a real advantage for families driving in from other provinces. Inform reception at check-in to arrange your space.

faqTitle: FAQ — Seekers Finders Rama IV Hotel Bangkok

faq.q: How far is Seekers Finders Rama IV Hotel from MedPark Hospital?
faq.a: Approximately 200 metres — a 2–3 minute walk along Rama IV Road. Turn right out of the hotel entrance and MedPark's entrance is on your left. No road crossings required.

faq.q: What is the starting price at Seekers Finders Rama IV Hotel?
faq.a: Rooms start from approximately ฿1,400–1,600/night for a Superior in the regular season. Deluxe rooms run around ฿1,800–2,200, and Suites from about ฿3,200. Always compare Agoda, Booking.com, and Trip.com before booking.

faq.q: Is Seekers Finders Rama IV Hotel near an MRT station?
faq.a: Yes. MRT Khlong Toei (Blue Line) is approximately 300 m away — a 4-minute walk. From there you can reach Silom, Sukhumvit, Chatuchak, and the rest of Bangkok directly.

faq.q: Does Seekers Finders Rama IV Hotel have a pool?
faq.a: Yes — a rooftop outdoor pool with Bangkok skyline views, especially striking at night. It is one of the most frequently praised features in guest reviews.

faq.q: Who is Seekers Finders Rama IV Hotel best suited for?
faq.a: Primarily families or companions staying near MedPark Hospital on a moderate budget. Also well-suited for business travellers needing the Khlong Toei area, or anyone wanting a clean, modern room with MRT access and free parking. Not ideal for those seeking a lively tourist area.

faq.q: Does the hotel offer free parking?
faq.a: Yes. Free parking is available for all guests — a significant convenience for families driving in from other provinces. Inform reception when checking in.
